steps.text: jade: open the config through the mod's own bind, registered as key.jade.config (ClientProxy.registerKeyBinding builds key.jade. + config, default KP_0) and consumed by JadeClient.onKeyPressed into HomeConfigScreen

jade: HomeConfigScreen.init places gui.jade.jade_settings at x width/2-5-maxWidth..width/2-5, y height/2-10..+20 with maxWidth min(max(100,text+8),240,width/2-40) = 100 at 640x360, so (215,170)-(315,190); (265,180) is its centre and its onPress opens WailaConfigScreen

jade: the search box is BaseOptionsScreen.init's NotUglyEditBox at (0,0,120,18); it overrides isMouseOver but not mouseClicked, so a click cannot focus it, and BaseOptionsScreen$1 refuses the InitialFocus event - one Tab is the route: the nav list before it refuses Tab (its entries keep the default null nextFocusPath) and the box accepts it

jade: type the pinyin of 显示提示框 (config.jade.display_tooltip); the box's responder is OptionsList.updateSearch, which lowercases the typed text and tests each entry message with message.contains(term). The box is a hand-rolled AbstractWidget, not an EditBox, so assert_focus_text cannot read it and the recorded match is the proof it took the text
